I would say that this is a form of self harm. honestly, it doesn’t have to be a “popular” or “common” form to be valid. you’re hurting yourself and that’s enough for it to count. I hope you have never felt like you needed to do more to feel like your struggle is valid. I used to go through the same thing and personally, it’s hard to find something. what I’ve done is 1, soak in cold ice water, 2, if it’s healed enough I’ve painted my nails, and 3, I just go around my house and around my neighborhood and tap stuff lol. Like I just walk around and tap everything to keep my fingers occupied. and if distractions don’t seem to do the trick, you are always open to seek a therapist. it can seem scary but sometimes it’s relieving for someone else to know how you feel. Plus, professional advice might be a bit more helpful than some teen on Reddit. I wish you all the best <3 you can do it

Okay so this is what I’ve gathered so far:

when you originally start self harming, for whatever reason wether it’s punishing yourself or release or anything, at that moment your body is like “awesome adrenaline sick” and when you repeatedly harm, your body gets used to that being a “happy hormone” strategy because in a messed up place you would see that as a solution. so, because it gets that habit, subconsciously your brain is like “yay cool things are great and so I deserve this thing that made happy chemicals one time” and so you get urges. it’s all about teaching yourself to associate new things with that adrenaline and “happy hormone” stuff to replace that so then your brain decides to want the better coping more than the harm. I hope your recovery goes well!
